I meet #C236196003Lancer#CDEF's sarcasm with a bit of my own.
Job's done now, and so is our contract.
I couldn't bring myself to ask #C236196003Lancer#CDEF what would become of her.

Venus, hear me? Earth's top 100 chart is
old news. It's all about the galactic charts
these days, galactic!

Once a fool, always a fool.
If I want to become a real idol,
I have to make a fresh, new start.

Through #C236196003Lancer#CDEF's help, our one-time enemy,
    we gained a way to contest #C236196003BB#CDEF―――

After making a shortcut to the old school from
the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF, please return to base.

#C236196003#FAMILY#CDEF, you appear to have accumulated
a lot of fatigue. I recommend that
you return for the moment to take a rest.

Searching the Labyrinth is nice and all,
but I should #C000246204return to the old school#CDEF to
briefly speak with #C236196003Kiara#CDEF.

I obtained the first #C000246204SG#CDEF.
Let's briefly return to #C000246204My Room#CDEF and sort
out the situation.

First thing to do is activate the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF.
That'll help move our search along.

We took more damage from our fight with #C236196003Lancer#CDEF
than I expected. Now would be a good time to head
back to the old school.
Luckily, there's a #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF near us.

Don't worry. I'll protect you, Darling.
So, continue on #C000246204ahead#CDEF.

Surely you're not telling me that you're
frightened? Even you understand that stopping

#C236196003#FAMILY#CDEF. After you activate the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF,

Even in cyberspace, you need proper rest.

Once you activate the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF,

I'll bet you're exhausted, #C236196003#NICK#CDEF.

#[Mr.][Ms.]##C236196003 #NICK#CDEF, return to base for now.
Let's discuss our plan
in the #C000246204Student Council Room#CDEF.

#C236196003Sakura#CDEF's worried state gets across to

She's right, it would be best if
we returned to the #C000246204Old School Building#CDEF.

Hrrrm? Where are you going, #C236196003#FAMILY
#GIVEN#CDEF? Where are you going,

For a second there, I was thinking about
leaving #C236196003Gatou#CDEF and heading back,
but it probably won't rest easy on my conscience,
so let's turn back.

Wait, Praetor. If we're going to head back,
it'll behoove us for the future to have
the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF activated.

Master, let's look for the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF.
It should be around here somewhere…

We don't need to walk all the way back.
We can use the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF to reach the
old school in a flash. Very nifty.

M-my stomach is at its limit…
I want to hurry back to #C000246204My Room#CDEF and get some rest…

Before we go to the next floor,
let's #C000246204head back to the Student Council Room#CDEF.
We need to hand over the data we got from #C236196003Green Archer#CDEF.
He gave his life to entrust us with it.

Huh? You're still in the #C000246204Sakura Labyrinth#CDEF?
Come on, there's nothing to do there.
Get your butt back here!

We'll talk about what comes next tomorrow,
so #C000246204come back and get some rest#CDEF.
After, drop by the Student Council Room.

We're in a race against time.
We need to hurry to the #C000246204Moon Cell's Core#CDEF――!

I can't let #C236196003Shinji#CDEF's hopes go to waste.
Let's press on so we can catch up to #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF!

Praetor, I've grown tired. Let us return
to My Room and have ourselves a bath.

I know how you feel, but knowing
when to rest is also part of the battle.
Let's head back to My Room.

Darling, now is the time for rest.
Let's return to our room and
recover our strength.

What an impatient #[man][woman]#. Laboring away
is not all there is to life, you know?
When it's time to rest, rest.

linhas.en:
That there―――is #C236196003#SVT#CDEF's primordial form,
unknown to even #SVT[her][him][her][him]#―――!

―――Hmph.
I was expecting to see something ghastly,
but that's quite some dress up.

Unlike me, looking like a monster, this is what
a proper Heroic Spirit looks like. That's your
Servant for you, #C236196003#FAMILY #GIVEN#CDEF.

Her smile was a mixture of excitement in the
face of a powerful foe―――
Along with the sorrow of being
flaunted with an unattainable light.

The limiter on your Servant will lift once
we beat that thing. You'll be able to acquire
a "principle" that rivals #C236196003BB#CDEF―――

As for how much load it'll put on your Servant,
it's not my problem. Take that concern up
with the person in question.

What's important is that this is my way of
reclaiming my pride, and only I can do it.

I'll help you all out―――
That in and of itself is my reward.

That's the dream I so badly wanted to
come true while I was stuck in that dark box.

I don't expect you to forgive me. Supposing
I were totally normal―as if―it would be
a shameless and inappropriate wish.

A fiery spirit now dwells thoroughly within #C236196003Lancer#CDEF,
the likes of which I've never seen in her before.

However―――It's impossible for one who
lived a life of evil to go and live a life of good.

Because the moment they reform to a life of good,
they become fully aware of their misdeeds and are
left ignited by their own sins.
THAT, is the greatest punishment given for a life of evil.

She was allowed to be evil.
The moment she deviates from that path,
her#ROFS0003#RUBS   sin#RUBE pride#REND will become a self-engulfing conflagration.

Well, the combustion goes for you, too.
That's why this calls for a goodbye concert.
My time playing idol ends here.

This will truly be my last number. Though it's
not my style―――For the first time in my life,
I'll sing for someone other than myself!

Taking up her brutal lance, the crimson diva dashes out.
Engaging her is an umbral Servant.
―――This is the one moment where good and evil swap sides.

for this girl, who was transformed into the Dragon's Daughter,
her final battle begins.

#C236196003#SVT#CDEF's unsealing was reminiscent of a flower,
scattering away in silence.
I can't complain, that was the ultimate stage.

Well? Did I look heroic?
Maybe I etched myself into this dump of a
memory area.

Without looking back at me,
#C236196003Lancer#CDEF smiles with satisfaction, saying, "hm."

I'm also tired, sweating, and my spirit is in
tatters. I'll go back and have my daily bath
until I get relaxed, then go sleep.

Ah, and just so you know,
I've quit it with the blood baths.

I'm not like #C236196003Saber#CDEF, but bathing in saffron is
actually pretty nice.

Because I know she takes the utmost pride
in her refusal of any and all sympathy.
I hereby graduate from playing "pretend idol."

Next time we meet, I'll be the real thing.
Look forward to it, #[piggy][squirrely]#.

Seems like humanity isn't ready for my singing,
anyhow. I'll start by making a name for myself
on Venus and become like a goddess diva.

There you have it.
The rest is up to you, #C000246204Master#CDEF.

A star can't shine without a stage. Get rid of 
the mastermind behind all this and save the
universe―so I can do my shining.

I saw a portion of her face, which was not filled
with satisfaction. It was filled with regret
and straining to hold back tears.
…I'm losing sensation across my entire body.

#C236196003#SVT#CDEF's seal has been broken.
I have no more reason to be here.

My body drifts, my mind dims,
and the Labyrinth grows more distant.
